title: X4 Pro Licorice shell research source register
scope: Source-only research. No physical probe, SD/hardware access, firmware changes or secrets extraction.

sources.scope: Package format, native list/launch, XTCO limits and inferred RTC resume
sources.evidence_limit: Hardware install/launch report on 26102901; emulator tests; reverse engineering, explicitly distinguishes unexercised streamed and RTC paths.

sources.scope: Firmware generations, wake policy, home_app observation, USB mode and lockscreen uncertainty
sources.evidence_limit: Covers 261013 and 26102901; not a 26110201 test. NVS names are descriptive leads, not supported APIs.

sources.scope: API selection, system member presence, storage sandbox/quota, display limits and historical image behavior
sources.evidence_limit: Living chronological document. Opening API0.8 no-network conclusion is superseded by later API2.9 results. No system open signature, target grammar or successful launch example supplied.

sources.scope: Current app capabilities, API2 selection, API2.18 requirements, store and host update claims
sources.evidence_limit: Mixes old API2.9 overview with newer per-app requirements. Firmware key changes are possible. Store/host updates do not demonstrate app-to-app package writes.
Official docs site is invite-only; extracted files are not committed. This research did not access or reconstruct those docs.

sources.scope: Packer enforces supported in-RAM code-section size
sources.evidence_limit: Packer rejection is not proof that reversed larger streamed firmware path is impossible.
Source comments report 30–3600 seconds and per-session reset; not this project's hardware verification.
Approximate 2 MiB statement does not guarantee a fixed budget for every build or exclude native allocations.
Upstream app account; not an official constant guaranteed across builds.

sources.scope: ROM/second-stage flash boot and deep-sleep RTC entry
sources.evidence_limit: SoC startup description, not proof of a particular Licorice startup policy. Licorice reversed images report v6.1-dirty.

sources.scope: Normal SPI flash execution versus ROM USB/UART download
sources.evidence_limit: Describes ROM modes. Does not test Xteink board wiring or establish an SD/USB-storage boot path.

sources.scope: Light/deep sleep and retained state distinctions
sources.evidence_limit: Mechanism description; a named stock UI action cannot be assigned a sleep mode without build-specific evidence.

sources.scope: Local 17-game hub 30/32 files, 383525/524288 code bytes; prior preservation receipts; pending physical checks
sources.evidence_limit: Filesystem/host evidence is not reader launch, startup, sleep or rendering verification. No private save/firmware content was included.

search_limits.result: Names observed in upstream API2.9 inventory; no exact public signature/target grammar or app-to-app launch demonstration found.
search_limits.note: GitHub code search returned zero with incomplete_results=true; absence is not proof of unsupported functionality.

search_limits.result: Public upstream access note says invite-only, extracted docs uncommitted.
search_limits.note: Do not cite unavailable official text as if read.
A product-design analogy does not establish ESP32-S3 external boot.
